# Enginemailer

Enginemailer is an email marketing platform that enables businesses to manage contacts, design campaigns, and send personalized emails.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/enginemailer/.

## Actions

- **Check Export Status V2** (read-only): Check status of a previously requested csv report export.
- **Create Campaign**: Create a new email campaign.
- **Export CSV Report V2**: Export a transactional email report as csv.
- **Get Subcategories** (read-only): Retrieve subcategories for a given category.
- **Insert Subscriber**: Add a new subscriber with optional custom fields.
- **List Campaign** (read-only): Retrieve a list of undelivered campaigns.
- **Pause Campaign**: Pause a scheduled email campaign.
- **Send Campaign**: Send an email campaign immediately.
